Aerial Retreat.name: Aerial Retreat
Aerial Retreat.description:
The hippogriff makes a talon Golpe, then Flies with a +10-pies bonificador de circunstancia to its fly Velocidad. The hippogriff and its rider gain a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to AC against reactions triggered by this movement.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.evvqmXIieuMwFMJT]{Efecto: Retreat (Rider)}

Antler Catapult.name: Antler Catapult
Antler Catapult.description: The elk Steps once and then makes an antlers Golpe. If it moved and hits, the elk can fling its target into the space it just left, which is forced movement.

Badger Rage.name: Badger Rage
Badger Rage.description:
Requisitos The badger isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} or raging.

The badger enters a state of pure rage that lasts for 1 minute, until there are no enemies it can perceive, or until it falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, whichever comes first. It can't voluntarily stop raging. While raging, the badger is affected in the following ways.

  • It deals 4 daño adicional with its bite attacks and 2 daño adicional with its claw attacks.
  • It takes a –1 penalty to AC.
  • It can't use actions that have the concentrate rasgo. The animal companion can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} even while raging. After it has stopped raging, it can't use Badger Rage again for 1 minute.

Bay.name: Bay
Bay.description: The shadow hound releases an eerie bay, attempting to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} each foe in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:20]. These Demoralize attempts don't require a language and don't take any penalty due to not sharing a language.

Bear Hug.name: Bear Hug
Bear Hug.description:
Requisitos The bear's last action was a successful claw Golpe.

The bear makes another claw Golpe against the same target. If this Golpe hits, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, as if the bear had successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grappled} the target.

Blood Feast.name: Festín de sangre
Blood Feast.description:
Tu compañero animal vampírico ataca a un enemigo sangrante y bebe su sangre. Tu compañero da un Golpe contra la criatura, que sufre daño persistente por sangrado. El Golpe causa 2d8 daño adicional. Si el Golpe acierta y causa daño, tu compañero vampírico obtiene tantos Puntos de Golpe temporales como la mitad de tu nivel durante 1 minuto.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.q6fSAYeFEf1B5Bu7]{Efecto: Festín de sangre}

Boar Charge.name: Boar Charge
Boar Charge.description: The boar Strides twice in a straight line and then makes a tusk Golpe. As long as it moved at least 20 pies, it gains a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to its tirada de ataque.

Bony Constriction.name: Bony Constriction
Bony Constriction.description:
Requisitos The constrictor has a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}.

The skeletal constrictor deals @Damage[12[piercing]] daño to the grabbed creature with its sharp ribs; the creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|basic|against:bony-constriction] save. If the constrictor is a specialized companion, increase this daño to @Damage[20[piercing]|shortLabel]. This uses a entrenado DC using the constrictor's Constitution modifier, or an expert DC if the constrictor is specialized.

Bouncing Slam.name: Bouncing Slam
Bouncing Slam.description: The gibtas Leaps toward a Medium or smaller creature, landing in the creature's space and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shoving} the creature. If the Shove fails, the gibtas bounces out of the target's square to an adjacent square of the target's choosing.

Bounding Retreat.name: Bounding Retreat
Bounding Retreat.description: The antelope Leaps twice. If it has a rider, it can leave them in an empty space as it Leaps out of it.

Breach.name: Breach
Breach.description: The orca Swims up to its swim Velocidad, then Leaps vertically out of the water up to 25 pies in the air, making a Golpe against a creature at any point during the jump (this lets it attack a creature within 30 pies of the water's surface). After the Golpe, the orca splashes back down into the water.

Bucking Frenzy.name: Bucking Frenzy
Bucking Frenzy.description: The war pig transforms any fear it feels into fury before kicking wildly. Reduce the war pig's asustado value by 1 (minimum 0). The war pig then makes hoof Golpes against up to three different foes within its reach. These Golpes each take a –2 penalty to their tiradas de ataque unless the war pig began its turn with the asustado condition. Each attack counts toward the war pig's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty only increases after all the attacks have been made.

Burrowing Ambush.name: Burrowing Ambush
Burrowing Ambush.description: Tu mole Burrows and makes a Golpe. If the mole began its movement underground, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} for this attack.

Careful Withdraw.name: Careful Withdraw
Careful Withdraw.description: The legchair carefully extricates you from a dangerous situation. It Steps twice and then Strides.

Cat Pounce.name: Cat Pounce
Cat Pounce.description: The cat Strides and then Golpes. If it was @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} at the start of its Cat Pounce, it remains undetected until after the attack.

Circling Flyby.name: Circling Flyby
Circling Flyby.description: Tu air elemental flies in a circle, blowing gusts at tu foes before returning back to its starting position. The air elemental Flies up to half its Velocidad, makes two gust Golpes, then Flies up to half its Velocidad again to return to its original location. Both attacks count toward the air elemental's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after it makes both attacks.

Constrict.name: Constrict
Constrict.description:
Requisitos The snake has a smaller creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}.

The snake deals @Damage[12[bludgeoning]] daño to the grabbed creature; the creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|basic] save against tu class DC. If the snake is a specialized animal companion, increase this daño to @Damage[20[bludgeoning]|shortLabel].

Crab Cannon.name: Crab Cannon
Crab Cannon.description: Tu durian crab curls itself up tightly, taking the shape of a ball. It then launches itself with its powerful claw at a target within 20 pies. When it lands, it makes a claw Golpe, except the daño is bludgeoning instead of piercing. On a hit, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round and the Golpe deals an additional @Damage[1d8[untyped]] daño, or 2d8 daño adicional if tu crab is specialized.

Darting Attack.name: Darting Attack
Darting Attack.description: The raptor Steps up to 10 pies and then Golpes, or Golpes and then Steps up to 10 pies.

Darting Stab.name: Darting Stab
Darting Stab.description: The giant wasp Flies up to 15 pies and then Golpes, or Golpes and then Flies up to 15 pies.

Death Roll.name: Death Roll
Death Roll.description:
Requisitos The crocodile has a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}.

The crocodile tucks its legs and rolls rapidly, twisting its victim. It makes a jaws Golpe with a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to the tirada de ataque against the grabbed creature. If it hits, it also knocks the creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. If it misses, it releases the creature.

Death from Above.name: Death from Above
Death from Above.description: The flying squirrel crashes down onto a target, furiously clawing at it. The flying squirrel falls to an empty space next to the target, taking no daño, and makes two claw Golpes. Both attacks count toward its multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after both attacks have been made.

Defensive Curl.name: Defensive Curl
Defensive Curl.description: The pangolin coils into a ball to defend itself. It gains a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to AC. Any creature that hits the pangolin with a melee ataque sin armas while it's in its Defensive Curl take [[/r 2d6[persistent,bleed]]] daño. The pangolin can't move, use its ataques sin armas, or take other actions that require it to use its limbs while in its Defensive Curl, but it can unfurl as a single action, ending the effects of Defensive Curl.

Defensive Curl (Hermit Krait).name: Defensive Curl (Hermit Krait)
Defensive Curl (Hermit Krait).description: The hermit krait pulls its heads into its shell to protect itself. It gains a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to AC and a +4 bonificador de circunstancia to any check to pretend to be a mundane shell. Any creature that hits the hermit krait with a melee ataque sin armas while it's in its Defensive Curl takes @Damage[2d6[persistent,poison]] daño as one of the krait's heads lashes out from within the shell. While in its shell, the hermit krait can't move or take other actions that require using its limbs, but it can extend out of the shell as a single action, ending the effects of Defensive Curl.

Disgusting Gallop.name: Disgusting Gallop
Disgusting Gallop.description:
The zombie mount Strides twice, spraying putrid spittle as it runs. Once during this movement, elige a creature adjacent to the zombie mount. The spittle splashes on it, and the creature must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:disgusting-gallop] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

The creature is then temporarily immune to the spittle for 24 hours. This uses a entrenado DC using the zombie mount's Constitution modifier, or an expert DC if the mount is specialized.

Distracting Spray.name: Distracting Spray
Distracting Spray.description:
The capybara sprays an adjacent target with its scent glands. The target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:distracting-spray] save. Wiping off the musk takes an Interactuar action and ends the effect. This uses a entrenado DC using the capybara's Constitution modifier or an expert DC if the capybara is specialized.

Éxito crítico The creature is unaffected.

Éxito The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 round.

Fallo The creature is torpe 1 for 1 minute.

Fallo crítico The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} for 1 minute.

Diving Skewer.name: Diving Skewer
Diving Skewer.description: The wyvern Flies up to half its Velocidad and then makes a stinger Golpe. If the Golpe hits, the target is also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. If the Golpe critically succeeds, the target also takes @Damage[2d6[persistent,poison]] daño.

Drench.name: Drench
Drench.description: Tu water elemental drenches nearby fires to extinguish them. Tu elemental puts out all fires in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5]. It extinguishes all non-magical fires automatically and attempts to counteract magical fires (its counteract modifier is equal to its attack modifier with its wave Golpe, unmodified by any bonuses or effects that apply to tiradas de ataque).

Enamoring Exhalation.name: Enamoring Exhalation
Enamoring Exhalation.description: Tu riding dragonet enraptures those nearby, exhaling a @Template[type:cone|distance:15] of pheromones that fascinates those within it. Each creature in the area is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with you and tu dragonet until the end of tu next turn unless it succeeds at a @Check[type:fortitude|against:enamoring-exhalation|basic:true] save. This uses a entrenado DC using the dragonet's Charisma modifier, or an expert DC if the dragonet is specialized.

Extend Pseudopod.name: Extend Pseudopod
Extend Pseudopod.description: Tu chair lengthens itself, granting its pseudopod Golpe the reach 10 pies rasgo until the beginning of tu next turn.

Feast on the Fallen.name: Feast on the Fallen
Feast on the Fallen.description:
Frecuencia una vez por hora

Desencadenante A creature adjacent to the vulture is reduced to 0 Puntos de Golpe

The vulture consumes a piece of the defeated foe, regaining @Damage[18[healing]] Puntos de Golpe. If the vulture is a specialized animal companion, increase the Puntos de Golpe regained to @Damage[30[healing]|shortLabel].

Fire Breath.name: Fire Breath
Fire Breath.description:
Frecuencia una vez por hora

The riding drake breathes a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] of fire, dealing @Damage[(max(1,floor(@actor.level/2)))d6[fire]|options:area-damage]{1d6 daño de fuego for every 2 levels} the drake has to all creatures in the area (@Check[reflex|basic|options:area-effect|against:fire-breath] save). This uses a entrenado DC using the drake's Constitution modifier or an expert DC if the drake is specialized.

Flamethrower.name: Flamethrower
Flamethrower.description:
Frecuencia once per 10 minutes

The fire elemental makes a tendril Golpe against all creatures in a @Template[type:line|distance:60], even those that aren't in the tendril Golpe's reach. All these Golpes count toward the fire elemental's multiple attack penalty, but it doesn't increase until all the Golpes.

Float.name: Float
Float.description:
Desencadenante The umbrella mushroom is falling.

The umbrella mushroom inflates buoyant air bladders and begins rotating to arrest the fall. It slows its descent to 60 pies per round. It can take this reaction even when @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}.

Flower Dance.name: Flower Dance
Flower Dance.description: The sundaflora stands tall on its hind legs and begins to wave and dance, showing off its dazzling beauty to distract tu attackers. It attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint} the target creature, using its [[/act feint skill=performance]]{Performance } skill instead of Deception. If successful (or critically successful), the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} to you, rather than to tu sundaflora.

Flyby Attack.name: Flyby Attack
Flyby Attack.description: The bird Flies and makes a talon Golpe at any point along the way.

Flying Strafe.name: Flying Strafe
Flying Strafe.description: The griffon Flies up to its fly Velocidad and makes two talon Golpes at any point, each against a different creature.

Frightening Display.name: Frightening Display
Frightening Display.description: Tu ape makes a loud and frightening display, throwing a foe off balance. The ape attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} the target creature; this display gains the visual rasgo and doesn't require language. While @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado} by this ability, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} to tu ape.

Gallop.name: Gallop
Gallop.description: The horse Strides twice at a +10-pies bonificador de circunstancia to Velocidad.

Gnash.name: Gnash
Gnash.description:
Requisitos The severed head's last action was a successful jaws Golpe.

Tu severed head violently shakes itself back and forth, trying to tear away a mouthful of flesh. It makes another jaws Golpe against the same target. If the Golpe hits, it deals @Damage[1d6[persistent,bleed]] daño in addition to its usual daño.

Gnaw.name: Gnaw
Gnaw.description:
Requisitos The animal companion's last action was a successful jaws Golpe.

The Golpe's target takes @Damage[1d6[persistent,bleed]] daño and takes a –10-pies penalización de estado to its Velocidad until it removes the daño de sangrado. If the hyena is a specialized animal companion, the daño persistente de sangrado increases to @Damage[2d6[persistent,bleed]|shortLabel].

Go For the Eyes!.name: Go For the Eyes!
Go For the Eyes!.description:
The squox Strides, attempts an @Check[acrobatics|against:perception] check against an adjacent creature's Perception DC, and then makes a jaws Golpe.

Éxito crítico Thrown by the squox's sudden leap, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} until the end of the squox's next turn.

Éxito The target is only momentarily startled and is desprevenido until the end of the squox's current turn.

Fallo crítico The squox misjudges the distance to its target's face and falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Grab and Sting.name: Grab and Sting
Grab and Sting.description: The scorpion holds its foe in place with its pincers in order to sting it. It makes a pincer Golpe. If the Golpe hits, the target creature automatically becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by the scorpion, which then makes a stinger Golpe against it. The grabbed condition lasts until the end of tu next turn.

Grabbing Branches.name: Grabbing Branches
Grabbing Branches.description: Tu wood elemental surrounds a foe with branches, grabbing it in place. Tu wood elemental makes a branch Golpe; on a success, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by the wood elemental until the end of tu next turn unless tu wood elemental moves or the target Escapes.

Grabbing Trunk.name: Grabbing Trunk
Grabbing Trunk.description: The elephant grabs its foe with its trunk and carries it off. The elephant uses Athletics to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} a creature up to two sizes smaller than the elephant in its trunk. If its target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, the elephant repositions the target to another space in the elephant's reach.

Grip Throat.name: Grip Throat
Grip Throat.description: The hand attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} a Medium or smaller creature by the throat. If the Grapple succeeds, in addition to the normal effects, the creature has difficulty speaking. While it remains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by the hand, it must spend an extra action to perform any action that has the verbal rasgo.

Gulp Blood.name: Gulp Blood
Gulp Blood.description:
Requisitos The water wraith's last action was a successful jaws attack against a foe.

The water wraith gains 2d8 Puntos de Golpe temporales that last for 1 round, and the foe takes @Damage[2d6[persistent,bleed]] daño. If the water wraith has a specialization, the water wraith instead gains 3d8 Puntos de Golpe temporales, and the target takes @Damage[3d6[persistent,bleed]] daño. If the targeted creature has absolutely no vital fluids, this ability might not function, at the GM's discretion.

Hair Barrage.name: Hair Barrage
Hair Barrage.description: The tarantula flicks its legs, flinging spiky hairs in a @Template[type:cone|distance:15]. This deals @Damage[(4 + max(0,floor((@actor.level - 6) / 4)))d6[piercing]] daño with a @Check[type:reflex|against:hair-barrage|basic:true]. This uses a entrenado DC using the tarantula's Dexterity modifier or an expert DC if the tarantula is specialized. This daño increases by an additional 1d6 for every 4 levels tienes beyond 6th.

Hustle.name: Hustle
Hustle.description: The beetle moves at incredible speed. It Strides three times.

Knock Aside.name: Knock Aside
Knock Aside.description:
Requisitos The animal companion's last action was a successful headbutt Golpe.

The goat automatically pushes the target back 5 pies, or 10 pies if the required Golpe was a critical hit.

Liberating Bite.name: Liberating Bite
Liberating Bite.description: The mongoose makes a jaws Golpe that can help creatures break free of restraint, like the grasp of a cobra. If the Golpe hits, each creature grappled or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by the target can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} as a free action.

Lizard Leap.name: Lizard Leap
Lizard Leap.description: The keulia Leaps and then makes a bite Golpe. As long as it moved at least 10 pies, its Golpe deals an additional @Damage[1d6[piercing]] daño, or @Damage[2d6[piercing]] daño if tu keulia is nimble or savage.

Lock Jaw.name: Lock Jaw
Lock Jaw.description:
Requisitos The boarhound's last action was a successful jaws Golpe.

The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, as if the boarhound successfully Grappled the target.

Long Stomp.name: Long Stomp
Long Stomp.description: Tu giraffe Strides twice and then makes a hoof Golpe. As long as it moved at least 20 pies, it deals an additional @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]] daño. Increase this to @Damage[2d6[bludgeoning]|shortLabel] if tu giraffe is specialized.

Lumbering Knockdown.name: Lumbering Knockdown
Lumbering Knockdown.description: Tu triceratops Strides up to 10 pies, then makes a horns Golpe. On a success, the target is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Lurching Rush.name: Lurching Rush
Lurching Rush.description: The monitor lizard Strides and then makes a jaws Golpe. If it moved at least 20 pies away from its starting position, it gains a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to this tirada de ataque.

Overwhelm.name: Overwhelm
Overwhelm.description: The tyrannosaurus bears down on an enemy and pins it with its jaws. The tyrannosaurus makes a jaws Golpe; on a hit, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}

Pick at the Meat.name: Pick at the Meat
Pick at the Meat.description:
Requisitos The animal companion's last action was a successful jaws Golpe.

Tu bird picks at the wound it just created. The target of its jaws Golpe takes @Damage[1d8[bleed]] daño, or @Damage[2d8[bleed]] daño if the bird is specialized.

Poisonous Sweep.name: Poisonous Sweep
Poisonous Sweep.description: The salamander secretes poison from the glands on its tail and bludgeons an enemy to apply it to them. It makes a tail Golpe. If the Golpe hits, the target takes an additional @Damage[1d6[persistent,poison]] daño. If tu salamander is nimble or savage, increase this daño to @Damage[2d6[persistent,poison]] daño.

Possessing Strike.name: Possessing Golpe
Possessing Strike.description:
Frecuencia una vez por hora

Tu gray bladeling attempts to inject a malevolent soul fragment into a victim to seize control of their actions. The gray bladeling makes a blade Golpe against a living creature. If it hits and deals daño, the target must attempt a Will tirada de salvación against tu class DC or conjuro DC, whichever is higher. Regardless of the result, the target is temporarily immune to Possessing Golpe for 24 hours.

Éxito crítico The target is unaffected.

Éxito The target fights off the possessing soul fragment but is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Fallo The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round and can't use offensive actions against you or tu gray bladeling.

Fallo crítico As failure, but if the target takes daño from an attack or conjuro, the DC of the prueba plana to recover from the confusion is 15.

Pterosaur Swoop.name: Pterosaur Swoop
Pterosaur Swoop.description: The pterosaur Flies up to its Velocidad and makes one beak Golpe at any point during that movement.

Raging Stampede.name: Raging Stampede
Raging Stampede.description: The yzobu Strides and then makes a horn Golpe. If the Golpe hits, the target is pushed 10 pies.

Rhinoceros Charge.name: Rhinoceros Charge
Rhinoceros Charge.description: The rhino Strides and makes a horn Golpe at the end of its Zancada. As long as the rhino moved at least 20 pies, the horn Golpe deals 1d8 daño adicional perforante, or 2d8 daño adicional if tu rhino is nimble or savage.

Rolling Charge.name: Rolling Charge
Rolling Charge.description: The cragstone bear tucks itself into a ball and Strides twice in a straight line. It can make a slam Golpe against one creature it's adjacent to at any point during this movement. If the Golpe is a critical hit, the target is also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Rolling Knockdown.name: Rolling Knockdown
Rolling Knockdown.description: Tu earth elemental rolls along the ground like a bowling ball and knocks a foe over. It Strides up to 10 pies then makes a fist Golpe. If it hits, the target is also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Sand Stride.name: Sand Zancada
Sand Stride.description: The camel Strides twice with a +5-pies bonificador de circunstancia to Velocidad, ignoring difficult terrain caused by rubble, sand, and uneven ground made of earth and stone.

Screaming Skull.name: Calavera aulladora
Screaming Skull.description:
El esqueleto se quita la calavera y la lanza, dando un Golpe de mandíbulas con alcance 20 pies (6 m). Sin importar si acierta o no, el objetivo y todos los enemigos a 10 pies (3 m) deben realizar una salvación de @Check[will|against:screaming-skull] o quedan @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 1}, o @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 2} con un fallo crítico. Esto utiliza la CD entrenada del modificador por Carisma del esqueleto o experta si el esqueleto está especializado.

Al inicio del siguiente turno del esqueleto, la cabeza bota, rueda o vuela para volver a fijarse al cuerpo. El esqueleto queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Ciego} mientras su cabeza está lejos.

Scurry.name: Scurry
Scurry.description: Tu chetamog takes any combination of two Zancada or Climb actions. It has a +10-pies bonificador de circunstancia to its Velocidad during these Strides.

Seedpod Spring.name: Seedpod Spring
Seedpod Spring.description: A seedpod within the chair bursts and uncoils, releasing a light clump of cottony material. Tu rootball chair Leaps up to 30 pies vertically or horizontally and drifts down, sinking 5 pies for every 5 pies traveled horizontally and causing you to take no falling daño. The cottony material disperses when you land.

Shred.name: Shred
Shred.description: The shark viciously rips into the wound. The target of the shark's Golpe takes @Damage[1d8[slashing]] daño (@Damage[2d8[slashing]|shortLabel] for a mature shark or @Damage[3d8[slashing]|shortLabel] for a specialized companion).

Snatch.name: Snatch
Snatch.description: The roc Golpes a creature with its talon and then attempts to Grab the creature. If the Grab is successful, the roc then Flies up to half its speed, carrying that creature along with it.

Snatch and Zap.name: Snatch and Zap
Snatch and Zap.description: The Ulgrem-Lurann bites down hard and unleashes an electrical discharge. It makes a jaws Golpe. If the Golpe hits, the target creature automatically becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by the Ulgrem-Lurann and takes @Damage[1d4[electricity]] daño (@Damage[2d4[electricity]|shortLabel] for a mature Ulgrem-Lurann or @Damage[3d4[electricity]|shortLabel] for a specialized companion). The grabbed condition lasts until the end of tu next turn, though the Ulgrem-Lurann can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} to attempt to extend the duration as normal.

Spiked Bunker.name: Spiked Bunker
Spiked Bunker.description: Tu metal elemental surrounds itself with protective metal spikes, hunkering down defensively. It gains a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to AC. Any creature that hits the metal elemental with a melee ataque sin armas while it's in its Spiked Bunker takes @Damage[2d6[piercing]] daño (or @Damage[3d6[piercing]] daño if tu metal elemental has a specialization). The metal elemental can't move, Golpe, or take other actions that require it to use its body while in its Spiked Bunker, but it can retract the bunker as a single action, ending the effects.

Spit.name: Spit
Spit.description: The bacallia regurgitates a portion of its stomach's contents as a ranged spit Golpe that deals a base of 1d6 daño de ácido with a range increment of 10 pies. The daño is 2d6 for a mature bacallia and 3d6 for a specialized one. A living creature hit with this Golpe is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical hit).

Spring Kick.name: Spring Kick
Spring Kick.description: The kangaroo balances on its tail and lashes out with a powerful two-legged kick. The kangaroo makes a pies Golpe. If it hits, the target is pushed back 10 pies. On a critical hit, they are also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Suction Vortex.name: Suction Vortex
Suction Vortex.description:
Requisitos The ravenous drake doesn't have a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} in its jaws

Efecto The ravenous drake draws in a powerful intake of breath, attempting to pull a foe within 10 pies toward it. The drake attempts an @Check[athletics|against:fortitude] check against the foe's Fortitude DC. On a success, the ravenous drake pulls the foe up to 10 pies to be adjacent to it. This movement is forced movement. On a critical success, the foe is also grabbed by the drake's jaws until the beginning of tu next turn.

Sudden Retreat.name: Sudden Retreat
Sudden Retreat.description:
The hippocampus makes a tail Golpe, then Swims with a +10-pies bonificador de circunstancia to its swim Velocidad. The hippocampus and its rider gain a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to AC against reactions triggered by this movement.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.evvqmXIieuMwFMJT]{Efecto: Retreat (Rider)}

Swimming Snap.name: Swimming Snap
Swimming Snap.description: The giant eel Swims and makes a jaws Golpe at any point along the way.

Tail Escape.name: Tail Escape
Tail Escape.description:
Frecuencia once per 10 minutes

Requisitos The giant rock tuatara is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

The giant rock tuatara detaches its tail to free itself from an enemy's grip. It automatically Escapes and can Dar un paso. It then can't use its tail slam Golpe until it can regenerate its tail, which takes 10 minutes or an application of healing magic that restores Puntos de Golpe.

Tail Swipe.name: Tail Swipe
Tail Swipe.description: Tu draft lizard sweeps its tail, making tail Golpes against up to two adjacent foes. Each attack counts toward the draft lizard's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty only increases after all the attacks have been made.

Take a Taste.name: Prueba un poco
Take a Taste.description:
Requisitos El zombi tiene a una criatura @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Apresada} o @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Neutralizada}.

El zombi trata de agarrar y morder a la criatura. El zombi hace un Golpe de mandíbulas contra la criatura. Este Golpe usa las mismas estadísticas que su Golpe de cuerpo a cuerpo normal, excepto que el daño es 1d10 e inflige daño perforante.

Takedown.name: Takedown
Takedown.description:
Requisitos The animal companion's last action was a successful jaws Golpe.

The wolf automatically knocks the target of its jaws Golpe @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Tearing Clutch.name: Tearing Clutch
Tearing Clutch.description: The terror bird makes a beak Golpe; on a successful hit, the target takes @Damage[2d6[persistent,bleed]] daño.

Telekinetic Assault.name: Asalto telecinético
Telekinetic Assault.description:
Frecuencia una vez por hora

El fantasma lanza una ráfaga de emociones, causando que los objetos pequeños y los escombros vuelen en una emanación de 20 pies (6 m), causando @Damage[(floor(@actor.level / 2))d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage]{1d6 daño contundente por cada 2 niveles} que tenga el fantasma (salvación @Check[reflex|basic|against:telekinetic-assault|options:area-effect]). Esto utiliza una CD entrenada del modificador de Carisma del fantasma o experta si el fantasma está especializado.

Telepathic Pounce.name: Telepathic Pounce
Telepathic Pounce.description:
The shotalashu hunts by pinning its foes with not just its claws, but with its mind as well. One creature within 30 pies must attempt a @Check[will|against:telepathic-pounce] save, with the following effects. This uses a entrenado DC using the shotalashu's Charisma modifier or an expert DC if the shotalashu is specialized.

Éxito crítico The creature is unaffected.

Éxito The creature takes a –5 pies penalización de estado to its Velocidades for one round.

Fallo The creature takes a –10 pies penalización de estado to its Velocidades for one round. The shotalashu can then @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}.

Fallo crítico The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for one round. The shotalashu can then Leap.

Throw Rock.name: Throw Rock
Throw Rock.description: The arboreal sapling Interacts to pick up a rock within reach or retrieve a stowed rock, then throws it with a ranged rock Golpe that deals a base of 1d6 daño contundente with a range increment of 30 pies. The daño is 2d6 for a mature arboreal sapling and 3d6 for a specialized one.

Tongue Grab.name: Tongue Grab
Tongue Grab.description: The giant frog lashes out with its tongue, making a tongue Golpe. If the Golpe hits, the target is automatically @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by the giant frog and pulled into a square adjacent to the frog. The grabbed condition lasts until the end of tu next turn.

Tongue Pull.name: Tongue Pull
Tongue Pull.description: The cave gecko snaps out its tongue, attempting to pull a foe within 10 pies toward it. The gecko attempts an Athletics check against the foe's Fortitude DC. On a success, the cave gecko pulls the foe next to it. This movement is forced movement. On a critical success, the foe is also @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} until the beginning of tu next turn.

Ultrasonic Scream.name: Ultrasonic Scream
Ultrasonic Scream.description:
The moth flaps its wings and emits ultrasonic squeaks that scramble the senses of nearby creatures. Elige one creature within 30 pies of the moth. That creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:ultrasonic-scream] save. This uses a entrenado DC using the moth's Constitution modifier or an expert DC if the moth is specialized.

Éxito The target treats all creatures as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto} on its next attack before the start of tu next turn.

Fallo The target treats all creatures as concealed until the start of tu next turn.

Fallo crítico As failure, and the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Unnerving Screech.name: Unnerving Screech
Unnerving Screech.description:
Tu skeletal bird of prey makes an earsplitting, unnatural screech, deafening and startling an enemy within 30 pies. The target must attempt a @Check[fortitude] save. The target is then temporarily immune for 1 hour. The asustado condition is a mental, emotion, and fear effect, but the creature can still be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} if it's immune to these.

Éxito crítico The target is unaffected.

Éxito The target is deafened for 1 round and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 1}.

Fallo The target is deafened for 1 minute and asustado 1.

Fallo crítico The target is deafened for 10 minutes and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 2}.

Weighted Kick.name: Weighted Kick
Weighted Kick.description: Tu augdunar gives a heavy kick with its hind legs, bringing the weight of its burden on the target. It makes a hoof Golpe. On a successful hit, the augdunar automatically Shoves the target back 5 pies (10 pies on a critical success).

Wing Thrash.name: Wing Thrash
Wing Thrash.description: The bat thrashes wildly with its wings, making wing Golpes against up to three adjacent foes. Each attack counts toward the bat's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty only increases after all the attacks have been made.

Wrapping Tendrils.name: Wrapping Tendrils
Wrapping Tendrils.description:
Requisitos The urchinpad's last action was a successful tendril Golpe.

The urchinpad makes another tendril Golpe against the same target. If this Golpe hits, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, as if the urchinpad had successfully Grappled the target.
